mapper.sql: certificate_id, user_id, pilgrimage_id, cert_type, serial_no, issued_at, file_key

SELECT cert.certificate_id, cert.user_id, u.nickname, cert.pilgrimage_id, c.course_id, c.name AS course_name, r.name AS region_name, cert.cert_type, cert.serial_no, cert.issued_at, cert.file_key FROM certificate cert JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cert.user_id LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = cert.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id LEFT JOIN region r ON r.region_id = c.region_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO certificate (user_id, pilgrimage_id, cert_type, serial_no, issued_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{pilgrimageId}, #{certType}, #{serialNo}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM certificate WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cert_type = #{certType} ORDER BY certificate_id LIMIT 1
WHERE cert.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cert.issued_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM certificate WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate SET file_key = #{fileKey} WHERE certificate_id = #{certificateId}
